summary: Use this page when retail teams want more Google reviews from in-store shoppers and need a review prompt that works at the counter, product handoff or bagging area without slowing checkout.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
Retail counters, boutiques, showrooms and pickup desks asking for more local reviews. Brands that want a cleaner review prompt than paper QR codes taped to the till area.

faq.question: What usually works best for retail review prompts?
faq.answer: The best format depends on how quickly the shopper moves through the counter and whether staff can naturally point to the prompt at the end of the purchase.

faq.question: Should retail teams start with stickers or review cards?
faq.answer: They should start with the format that matches the checkout behavior best, and many teams learn fastest by testing one card and one sticker in live store conditions.
